name: linear_create_comment
description: Add a comment to a Linear issue. Requires `issueId` (the issue UUID, from linear_list_issues / linear_get_issue) and `body` (markdown comment text). Returns { success, comment { id url } }.

issueId.description: The UUID of the issue to comment on.

body_defaults.query: mutation CreateComment($input: CommentCreateInput!) { commentCreate(input: $input) { success comment { id url } } }
